title: Dallas Soul Foodie AdvenTOUR
blurb:
Taste your way through Dallas’ Black-owned culinary scene with 7–8 menu favorites, local history, trivia, skyline views, and plenty of laughs along the way.

AdvenTOUR Highlights
✨ Enjoy 7–8 menu favorites from local black owned restaurants
✨ 3 appetizers + 3–4 entrée selections + dessert
✨ Discover fun facts about the history & founders of each stop
✨ Play Soul Food & Dallas trivia games
✨ Photo op in front of the Dallas skyline
✨ Ride comfortably in air-conditioned transportation

 What’s Included:
• Appetizers, Entree & Dessert
• AdvenTOUR Guide & Driver
• Transportation between stops
• Bottled water & snacks
• Tour booklet featuring the history of each stop
• Signature Spencer AdvenTOURS gift
• Guests will receive a full meal (not samples)

Because it’s never just a tour... it’s an AdvenTOUR.
